Maya Patel: Hi team — quick heads up, my passport shows my maiden name (M. Kaur) but my offer/ W-4 are under Maya Patel. I'm traveling on Day 1 and need to do I-9 in person. Can we still get verified?

Jenna (People Ops): Hey Maya — yes we can. Two common paths: 1) bring original passport + marriage certificate (or name-change doc) to the kiosk; or 2) do a notarized I-9 with an attester and upload per policy. Which is easier for you? :slightly_smiling_face:

Maya Patel: Marriage certificate is digital (scanned) and I can print it. I'd prefer the kiosk if there's a slot later that day. Any evening slots?

Jenna (People Ops): We have a 5:30pm kiosk slot at the NYC campus and a later 6:30pm at the satellite office. Book here: https://hr.redwood.internal/kiosk-booking (pick 'I-9 verification'). If you pick kiosk, bring both: original passport + printed marriage certificate + a second gov ID if possible.

Aaron - IT: FYI Maya — laptop courier shows 'delayed' for Day 1 delivery. If you book kiosk late, we can give you a temporary loaner at the campus desk so you can join Team standup. Ping me when you have a slot and I'll mark a loaner.

Samir - Hiring Manager: I can shift your Day-1 10am intro to 2pm if verification runs long. Also Maya — I'll do a quick 15-min welcome sync right after you finish so you don't miss kickoff.

Maya Patel: Thank you! Booking 5:30pm now. Do I need to upload the marriage cert anywhere beforehand?

Jenna (People Ops): No upload required before the kiosk, but please have a scanned copy in case the kiosk agent asks. After verification we'll mark I-9 complete and HR Bot will send confirmation. Also, quick reminder of acceptable docs for reference:

```
List A (one document): U.S. Passport OR Permanent Resident Card
OR
List B + List C (one of each): Driver's License (List B) + Social Security card (List C)
Replacement docs allowed for name change: marriage certificate, court order (bring originals).
```

HR Bot: Background check status for Maya Patel — CLEAR. No outstanding items. (ref: BG-48291) :white_check_mark:

Aaron - IT: Loaner reserved — MacBook Air (loaner-137) at campus desk. I put a note to hold until 6:45pm. Bring badge or photo ID to pick it up.

Jenna (People Ops): Perfect — Maya, once you're done at kiosk reply here and I'll update payroll/ badge provisioning. Also if you need dietary accommodations for Day-1 lunch, DM me — we've got veg/gluten-free options. :salad:

Maya Patel: Slot booked, will swing by after travel. Thanks everyone!

Jenna (People Ops): Great — safe travels. We'll see you at 2pm for the welcome sync if verification overlaps with morning. :wave:
